# Blood Eagle Spawns: All locations including map

![Blood Eagle Spawns: All locations including map](/uploads/728_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

The Blood Eagles are one of the most famous and feared raider factions in *Fallout 76*. Their origins go back to the time shortly after the Great War, when numerous survivors in Appalachia banded together to form various raider gangs. While some groups mainly fought for survival or captured resources, the Blood Eagle faction gradually developed from particularly brutal and chems-addicted followers. They reject any form of order and live exclusively according to the law of the strongest. They have appeared as a faction since 2103.

Today the blood eagles can be found in almost all regions of Appalachia. They often gain new followers by exploiting chems junkies or deliberately making prisoners addicted and thus binding them to the group. Within the faction, strength and ruthlessness determine rank, which is why power struggles and deadly rivalries are part of everyday life.

![](/uploads/skywalka55-fallout76-20260705-11-55-10.jpg)
